selection: VP016/025 selected after complete16 scores, to examine PC+1/-1.

observations.VP016: Both versions preserve the visible probe/insect/leaf with subtle contact motion. At this sampled resolution there is no clear qualitative gain commensurate with PC4->5; do not assert the minimal twitch was independently verified.
observations.VP025: Both versions leave the orange egg near the same position below the slide rather than showing travel up and down it. NormalPC5 versus offPC4 is not evidence that the original term fulfilled the requested process; SA2 remains appropriate for the missing action.

scope: Existing-video diagnostic observations, not rescoring or a representative quality statistic.
